# ADR 0007 — Freeze the WireFormat schema during soak
Status: accepted
Date: 2026-03-02
Decision: The WireFormat message schema is FROZEN for 60 days of production soak. No field additions or removals of any kind until the soak completes (~2026-05-01). Rationale: three consumer teams parse WireFormat with hand-rolled decoders; churn during soak risks silent corruption.
